projects.title: Let's Gopher It
projects.description: This was a group decision making web app that allows group members to connect to each other and the application will decide on a place for the group to go eat or go out. The decisions are made using information from the profiles that the members set up and the Yelp API for pulling all the local restaurants and places for activities. The back-end was written in Go and the front-end was done using Angular.js, CSS and HTML.

projects.title: Go Chat
projects.description: This is a silly web chat application that only allows you to chat using memes. The memes are pulled from imgur.com using a web crawler we created, the crawler grabs image URLs and their titles then compares the message the user typed to the titles of the images and chooses the best fit image. The image is then sent to everyone else on the chat. The back-end was written in Go and the front-end was done using Angular.js, CSS and HTML.
